acceptanceCriteria: citation to a file added after the cited revision reports missing-at-revision
range past end of file is reported
check reads only the object store (no checkout, no mutation)
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1195. Read-only check over a configurable set of markdown/text documents: parse `<path>[:<start>[-<end>]]` citations with an explicit or document-default revision, verify the path exists at that revision and the range is in bounds, optionally that an adjacent symbol name appears in the range. Report doc line, citation and reason (missing-at-revision, range-out-of-bounds, symbol-not-in-range), suggesting the nearest revision where the path exists when known. Runs against the object store with no checkout. Related: V1-1932 (row citation drift), V1-1530 (corvint's own line-citations-check).
title: GH #1195: revision-pinned source citation check for review documents (path:lines @ rev)
